summary: Checks build, vet, and test all exit 0. Blocking correctness defect in the changed Builder selection prompt: step 0 now makes a label scope FOREST_SCOPE_GITHUB_ONLY=1 and instructs 'selection is GitHub-only; do not list or take Powder jobs', but step 1 still says unconditionally 'If POWDER_AGENT is set, run powder list --mine ... If you already hold a job ... continue that job: powder show <id> then powder take <id>', and step 4 never checks FOREST_SCOPE_GITHUB_ONLY before declaring a Powder candidate eligible. A Builder dispatched in label scope with inherited POWDER_AGENT/POWDER_URL can therefore take and continue an out-of-scope held Powder job instead of the ready GitHub Issue that caused the poll. Required fix: gate step 1 (held-job enumeration and continuation) on FOREST_SCOPE_GITHUB_ONLY != 1, or add an explicit GitHub-only early stop for the held-Powder path.
